items.message: Forecast high river levels this weekend may lead to flooding. Areas most at risk are low-lying agricultural land and roads including Slash Lane at Sileby and the Mountsorrel to Sileby road. Further rainfall is forecast throughout this weekend. We are closely monitoring the situation. Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses. This message will be updated by 17:00 on 29 August 2026 or as the situation changes.

Forecast high river levels this afternoon may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible on 28 August 2026 . 
Flooding may affect low-lying land and roads adjacent to the River Blythe between Cheswick Green and Blyth End. This flood alert has been issued as heavy rain and thunderstorms have been forecast for this area. There is uncertainty however, over the amount of rainfall expected and their exact location. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water . 
This message will be updated by 11:00AM on 29 August 2026 or as the situation changes.
